# Real Battle
# recomended for free fire players

> Real Battle is a competitive Free Fire tournament platform for Indian players. Join solo, squad and Clash Squad battles, get room details in the app, and track verified results.

## About

Real Battle is a competitive Free Fire tournament platform built for Indian players. Tournament formats, entry fees and reward rules are published before a player joins. Results are checked against match proof before rewards are released.

## Tournament Information

Tournament cards on the website currently use clearly labelled sample/demo data. They are not live tournament inventory. Live tournament data will replace them once the verified tournament API is connected.

## App Download

The official download page is https://realbattle.in/download. The Android APK link, version, file size and checksum are published only after the production build is verified. Real Battle does not distribute builds through third-party mirrors.

## Important Information

- Support email: realbattleofficial@gmail.com
- Official download source: realbattle.in
- Social channels are added only after ownership is verified.
- Real Battle is intended for players aged 18 and above unless a specific tournament states otherwise.
- Rewards are not guaranteed and depend on tournament rules, performance and verification.
